title: Non-text Content
symptom: Image, icon, CAPTCHA, diagram or control has no equivalent non-text alternative or a misleading one
remediation: Write purpose-equivalent alt text; use empty alt on purely decorative images; label icon controls; provide structured long descriptions for complex visuals
verification: Inspect accessibility tree and screen reader output for functional and informative images, then verify decorative images are ignored
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Alt text must communicate purpose not pixels; CAPTCHA requires alternatives for different sensory modalities

title: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
symptom: Prerecorded audio lacks an equivalent transcript or silent video lacks an equivalent alternative
remediation: Provide a text equivalent for audio-only and text or equivalent audio track for video-only
verification: Compare all information and events in the media to the alternative including speakers and meaningful sound
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Does not replace caption requirements for synchronized video with audio

title: Captions (Prerecorded)
symptom: Prerecorded synchronized video speech or meaningful sound is inaccessible to deaf users
remediation: Provide accurate synchronized captions including speaker identification and meaningful non-speech sounds
verification: Review timing, completeness, names, sound effects and readability with captions enabled
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Auto-generated captions are not automatically accurate; media alternatives for text have a specific exception

title: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
symptom: Important visual action in prerecorded synchronized media is missing from spoken information
remediation: Provide audio description or an alternative for time-based media conveying meaningful visual information
verification: Compare narrative, diagrams, gestures and on-screen text to spoken descriptions or complete alternative
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Level A allows either option; 1.2.5 at AA specifically requires audio description

title: Captions (Live)
symptom: Live synchronized audio lacks usable live captions
remediation: Provide a reliable real-time captioning service for live synchronized media
verification: Observe a live session for delay, completeness, sound identification and speaker distinction
exceptions_and_pitfalls: A transcript published afterward does not replace live captions while broadcasting

title: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
symptom: Prerecorded video contains visually conveyed information not available through audio
remediation: Provide synchronized audio description for key visual information, using pauses or suitable described version
verification: Test the described track against actual visual information and verify playback selection
exceptions_and_pitfalls: A transcript alone does not satisfy this AA criterion

title: Sign Language (Prerecorded)
symptom: Prerecorded synchronized media lacks sign language interpretation
remediation: Provide qualified sign language interpretation for the audio portion of prerecorded synchronized media
verification: Review signed track with appropriate language-fluent reviewers and check synchronized presentation
exceptions_and_pitfalls: The choice of sign language is audience-specific; captions alone are not the same

title: Extended Audio Description (Prerecorded)
symptom: Normal audio gaps are too short to narrate visual information
remediation: Provide extended description that pauses the video when needed to convey information
verification: Review described content for full coverage with extensions and accessible controls
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Only relevant where ordinary audio descriptions cannot communicate sufficient detail

title: Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
symptom: Prerecorded synchronized or silent media lacks complete text-based equivalent
remediation: Provide a complete alternative for time-based media including speech, visual events and interactions
verification: Compare the media sequence end-to-end to alternative and assess equivalent information
exceptions_and_pitfalls: A short synopsis is not a complete media alternative

title: Audio-only (Live)
symptom: Live audio-only information has no equivalent accessible alternative
remediation: Provide a contemporaneous alternative for time-based media with equivalent information
verification: Observe actual live delivery and verify equivalence, completeness and timeliness
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Post-event transcript is not a live equivalent

title: Info and Relationships
symptom: Visual headings, labels, tables, lists and groups disappear or become misleading in semantic structure
remediation: Use native headings, lists, tables with headers, form labels and fieldsets; express relations in DOM or text
verification: Inspect semantic tree and linearized content with screen reader; verify headers and group labels
exceptions_and_pitfalls: An aria role alone cannot repair a fundamentally wrong native control or reading model

title: Meaningful Sequence
symptom: DOM or screen reader order differs from essential visual sequence
remediation: Align DOM order with meaningful reading order; avoid CSS reordering that changes only visual flow
verification: Navigate linearized reading and reading order at desktop and mobile widths
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Only sequences affecting meaning are in scope, not all visual positioning

title: Sensory Characteristics
symptom: Instructions identify a target only by color, location, shape, size or sound
remediation: Pair sensory descriptions with persistent text labels or unambiguous semantic names
verification: Attempt task without color or spatial cues; verify instructions still identify controls
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Color may supplement language but cannot be the only clue

title: Orientation
symptom: Layout locks portrait or landscape without necessity
remediation: Support both orientations with adaptive layout and preserved functions
verification: Rotate physical or emulated device in each task state and test all functionality
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Specific orientation can be essential for genuinely constrained content; document evidence

title: Identify Input Purpose
symptom: User-personal-information fields lack machine-readable purpose despite known autocomplete tokens
remediation: Use correct HTML autocomplete tokens such as name, email, street-address, tel for eligible fields
verification: Inspect computed autocomplete token and confirm autofill semantics for personal data
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Applies only to fields collecting information about user with purposes enumerated by WCAG

title: Identify Purpose
symptom: Regions, UI components or icons have no programmatically identifiable purpose
remediation: Provide consistent semantics and accessible purpose metadata with supported methods
verification: Inspect landmarks, icon semantics and accessible tree for the intended purpose
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Support for specific purpose vocabularies varies; avoid assuming arbitrary ARIA tokens work

title: Use of Color
symptom: Error, selection, link or chart series is identified only by hue
remediation: Add text labels, shapes, patterns, underlines or non-color indicators
verification: Review grayscale or forced-color mode and check meaning remains available
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Contrast alone does not solve color-only information encoding

title: Audio Control
symptom: Audio autoplays for more than 3 seconds without independent stop or volume control
remediation: Avoid autoplay; otherwise provide pause/stop or independent audio volume control
verification: Start page and confirm immediate keyboard-operable control for qualifying autoplay audio
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Non-interference criterion applies even to otherwise non-relied-upon content

title: Contrast (Minimum)
symptom: Readable foreground text has insufficient contrast with background
remediation: Use at least 4.5:1 for ordinary text and 3:1 for large text; evaluate text over images and states
verification: Measure rendered colors across interaction states and themes, then manually inspect overlays and imagery
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Logos and qualifying incidental content are exceptions; do not confuse with non-text contrast

title: Resize Text
symptom: Text at 200% zoom or text-only enlargement clips, overlaps or hides functionality
remediation: Use fluid relative typography and containers; remove fixed-height text boxes
verification: Increase text up to 200% without assistive technology and finish representative tasks
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Captions and images of text have stated exceptions; resizing via browser zoom may need complementary tests

title: Images of Text
symptom: Critical text is rasterized or baked into images instead of real text
remediation: Render information as selectable HTML/CSS text when presentation can be achieved with technology
verification: Inspect important graphic text at zoom and verify user styling and machine readability
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Essential presentation, customizable images of text and logos have exceptions

title: Contrast (Enhanced)
symptom: Normal text below 7:1 or large text below 4.5:1
remediation: Choose color tokens meeting enhanced thresholds across all text and modes
verification: Measure actual rendered foreground/background pairs in default and active states
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Logo and incidental exceptions apply; AA thresholds alone do not satisfy AAA

title: Low or No Background Audio
symptom: Background sounds interfere with spoken content in prerecorded audio-only material
remediation: Remove background, provide background-off track, or keep sound at least 20 dB lower except brief sounds
verification: Listen critically and measure levels for the qualifying audio recordings
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Applies to primarily foreground speech, with CAPTCHA, audio logo and musical exceptions

title: Visual Presentation
symptom: Users cannot adjust presentation of blocks of text to readable widths, colors or spacing
remediation: Offer a mechanism for customizable foreground/background, width, alignment, spacing and resizing
verification: Exercise all specified text presentation adjustments with representative paragraphs
exceptions_and_pitfalls: This is AAA customization for blocks of text, not mandatory identical styling for all UI

title: Images of Text (No Exception)
symptom: Non-essential information is encoded as an image of text
remediation: Replace informational text graphics with real text; preserve images only for decoration or essential presentation
verification: Audit all informative images of text, including banners and headings
exceptions_and_pitfalls: AAA removes the AA customizable-image exception; logos can remain essential

title: Reflow
symptom: Zoom or narrow view forces two-dimensional page scrolling to read standard content
remediation: Use responsive layout, wrap text and collapse columns; contain truly 2D widgets locally
verification: At 320 CSS px wide for vertical content and 256 CSS px high for horizontal content verify no information or function loss
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Tables, maps, diagrams and other intrinsically 2D parts have limited exceptions, not whole-page exemption

title: Non-text Contrast
symptom: State indicators, input boundaries or essential chart marks blend into adjacent colors
remediation: Ensure required UI identification and meaningful graphics achieve at least 3:1 contrast with adjacent colors
verification: Measure required visual indicators in all states and inspect meaningful graphic parts
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Inactive UI and unmodified user-agent appearance have exceptions; not all decorative outlines are required

title: Text Spacing
symptom: Content clips or buttons break when users override spacing
remediation: Allow line-height 1.5, paragraph-spacing 2x font, letter-spacing .12em and word-spacing .16em with no loss
verification: Inject all four overrides simultaneously and inspect fields, dialogs, navigation and content
exceptions_and_pitfalls: This tests resilience to user changes, not a rule that sites must default to those values

title: Content on Hover or Focus
symptom: Tooltips or popovers vanish before they can be read, obscure content or cannot dismiss
remediation: Make triggered content dismissible where required, hoverable and persistent until permitted dismissal
verification: Hover/focus, move pointer into popup, press Escape and verify timing and dismissal behavior
exceptions_and_pitfalls: There are exceptions to dismissibility for error content or content not obscuring other content

title: Keyboard
symptom: Feature works only via pointer, drag or gesture when keyboard equivalent is possible
remediation: Use native keyboard-operable controls; implement expected keys for custom widgets
verification: Complete every function with keyboard only including menus, uploads and overlays
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Some input depending on path of movement has a narrow exception, not permission for pointer-only navigation

title: No Keyboard Trap
symptom: Keyboard focus enters widget but cannot leave using ordinary keyboard action
remediation: Provide normal Tab/Shift+Tab escape or clear instructions for nonstandard exit
verification: Keyboard through all components and confirm focus can exit; test overlays and embedded content
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Non-interference applies even to non-conforming third-party content

title: Keyboard (No Exception)
symptom: Content relies on non-keyboard movement paths even when keyboard alternative possible
remediation: Supply keyboard control for every function with no path-dependent exception
verification: Operate all features using only keyboard across every meaningful state
exceptions_and_pitfalls: AAA removes the path-based exception of 2.1.1

title: Character Key Shortcuts
symptom: Unmodified letter, number or punctuation shortcuts trigger during speech input or typing
remediation: Allow turning them off, remapping to a modifier, or limit activity to focused component
verification: Test shortcuts with focus in input fields and with voice dictation-like single characters
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Applies to single-character shortcuts; shortcuts with modifiers are outside this rule

title: Timing Adjustable
symptom: Session or form expires without allowed time adjustment or exception
remediation: Provide time-limit off, 10x adjustable, or advance warning with at least 20 seconds and at least ten extensions
verification: Reproduce timer expiry; verify exact exception or turn-off, adjustable, extend path
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Real-time, essential and 20-hour exceptions are conditional; security may require tailored evaluation

title: Pause, Stop, Hide
symptom: Moving, blinking, scrolling or auto-updating information prevents reading and has no required control
remediation: Provide pause, stop, hide or adjustable update mechanism where the specific movement/update conditions apply
verification: Observe duration, automatic start, concurrency and controls for moving and auto-updating regions
exceptions_and_pitfalls: There are distinct conditions for movement and auto-updating information; essential animation exception

title: No Timing
symptom: Task success depends on a nonessential timer
remediation: Remove time limits unless intrinsically part of real-time events or non-interactive synchronized media
verification: Complete scenarios at arbitrarily slow user pace and inspect exceptions
exceptions_and_pitfalls: AAA has narrower exceptions than 2.2.1

title: Interruptions
symptom: Nonemergency interruptions steal attention or input during important tasks
remediation: Allow users to postpone or suppress interruptions except emergencies
verification: Exercise notifications during form entry and complex flows; verify deferral path
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Emergency alerts are an explicit exception

title: Re-authenticating
symptom: Session expiry discards entered content after login renewal
remediation: Persist activity state through reauthentication without compromising security
verification: Let session expire mid-task, authenticate again and confirm previous task can continue
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Security design can preserve state without extending expired authentication credentials

title: Timeouts
symptom: User is not warned that inactivity can cause data loss
remediation: At start, disclose possible data loss after inactivity unless data is preserved for more than 20 hours
verification: Review notification and test inactivity persistence, recovery and loss
exceptions_and_pitfalls: A user must be informed about inactivity-based data loss, not necessarily given control over all timeouts

title: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
symptom: Flash effects exceed safe threshold and risk photosensitive reactions
remediation: Avoid flashing or verify under three flashes per second or below general/red-flash threshold
verification: Inspect video and animations with suitable flashing analysis and specialist review
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Dangerous flashing can interfere with whole page; never treat reduced-motion alone as sufficient

title: Three Flashes
symptom: Any page material flashes more than three times per second
remediation: Remove or slow flashes so content never exceeds three per second
verification: Evaluate all looping animation, video and transitions against strict frequency limit
exceptions_and_pitfalls: AAA does not permit the below-threshold alternative allowed at A

title: Animation from Interactions
symptom: Nonessential interaction-triggered motion causes discomfort with no disable option
remediation: Honor reduced-motion preference or provide a way to disable nonessential animation
verification: Set prefers-reduced-motion and trigger every motion-capable interaction
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Essential motion is exempt; user preference must also affect scripted/canvas animation

title: Bypass Blocks
symptom: Repeated navigation must be traversed on every page before main content
remediation: Provide working skip navigation or equivalent bypass to main content
verification: Keyboard Tab from page start and verify activation lands at meaningful main region
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Landmarks support navigation but an inaccessible or inert skip link still harms users

title: Page Titled
symptom: Browser tab title is blank, generic or misleading
remediation: Set a unique descriptive document title reflecting page purpose
verification: Inspect title across routes and client-side navigation including errors
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Changing heading text does not update document title automatically

title: Focus Order
symptom: Focus sequence breaks intended meaning or operation after modal/menu/layout changes
remediation: Align focus navigation with meaningful order and manage focus on state transitions
verification: Tab/Shift+Tab through dialogs, cards and responsive layouts in both directions
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Positive tabindex often hides structural problems and is rarely a good repair

title: Link Purpose (In Context)
symptom: Many identical vague links lack discoverable destination or action
remediation: Use specific link text or associated programmatically determinable context
verification: Review link text and programmatic context with screen reader links navigation
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Context must be available to assistive technology; nearby visual text alone might not count

title: Multiple Ways
symptom: There is no second means to locate a page within a set of pages
remediation: Provide navigation plus search, sitemap, index or another genuine way to find pages
verification: Find representative pages through at least two mechanisms
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Pages that are a step in a process are excluded; one-page applications need scope judgment

title: Headings and Labels
symptom: Sections or form controls have unclear or misleading headings and labels
remediation: Write descriptive headings and labels matching purpose, keep semantics intact
verification: Ask a reviewer to navigate headings and identify purposes without surrounding context
exceptions_and_pitfalls: This requires descriptive headings and labels where present, not a prescribed exact heading hierarchy

title: Focus Visible
symptom: Keyboard focus exists but has no visible indication
remediation: Preserve or create visible high-clarity focus styles for all keyboard-operable UI
verification: Tab through all interactive elements and confirm current focus indicator is perceivable
exceptions_and_pitfalls: WCAG 2.1 2.4.7 does not itself prescribe the newer WCAG 2.2 focus appearance metrics

title: Location
symptom: Users cannot tell where they are in a group of related pages
remediation: Provide breadcrumbs, hierarchical page map or equivalent location information
verification: Navigate nested pages and verify current location is consistently indicated
exceptions_and_pitfalls: AAA applies to a set of pages; not all single views need a breadcrumb

title: Link Purpose (Link Only)
symptom: Link purpose cannot be recognized from link text alone
remediation: Use self-contained descriptive accessible link names
verification: List links out of context in screen reader and verify purpose remains clear
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Ambiguity to users in general is an exception; differs from in-context A rule

title: Section Headings
symptom: Long body content has no useful section divisions
remediation: Organize body content into labelled sections with meaningful headings
verification: Read content via headings navigation and assess logical segments
exceptions_and_pitfalls: This criterion is about content sections rather than every custom UI control

title: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
symptom: Keyboard focus moves to a control completely covered by an author-created sticky header, banner, modal layer or footer.
remediation: Ensure the focused component is not entirely hidden behind author-created content. Adjust overlay geometry, scroll padding and scroll margins; on focus programmatically reveal the target where necessary.
verification: Tab and Shift+Tab through every control with sticky bars, drawers, validation and responsive states; confirm at least part of each focused component is visible.
exceptions_and_pitfalls: The minimum permits partial visibility. Consider movable content initial positions and user-opened overlays that can be dismissed without moving keyboard focus; do not confuse focus appearance or focus indicator visibility with control visibility.

title: Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced)
symptom: A focused field or button is partially cut off by an author-created overlay or sticky element.
remediation: Keep the entire keyboard-focused component unobscured by author-created content at all relevant screen sizes and zoom levels; reserve inset space and adjust scroll alignment.
verification: Keyboard-traverse all elements with overlays, sticky headers, footers and error banners active; confirm the whole component remains visible.
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Unlike 2.4.11 AA, partial visibility is not enough; determine whether occlusion is actually author-created and test complex dynamic states.

title: Focus Appearance
symptom: The keyboard focus indicator is so thin or subtle that the active control cannot be distinguished.
remediation: Provide a strong focus indicator meeting the area equivalent to a 2 CSS-pixel perimeter (or equivalent) and 3:1 pixel change contrast between focused and unfocused states; preserve clear geometry.
verification: Compare focused/unfocused rendering using pixel samples and measure indicator area; test at zoom, browser themes and high-contrast settings.
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Do not mistake 2.4.7 Focus Visible for this quantitative AAA rule. User-agent-controlled, non-author-adjustable indicators and indicators not distinguishable from the component itself have narrow defined exceptions; verify normative text.

title: Pointer Gestures
symptom: Pinch, multi-finger or path-based drag is the only way to operate a feature
remediation: Provide single-pointer alternative without path gesture such as buttons to zoom or reorder
verification: Perform all gesture-requiring actions with a single click/tap sequence
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Exception when a path-based or multipoint gesture is essential to function

title: Pointer Cancellation
symptom: Touch down or mouse down causes irreversible action too early
remediation: Trigger actions on up-event with abort/undo or use one of the other permitted patterns
verification: Press and move pointer away before release; ensure activation is canceled or undoable
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Essential down-event actions have an exception; evaluate touch and mouse

title: Label in Name
symptom: Accessible name differs from visible button label, breaking voice activation
remediation: Include exact visible label words in accessible name, preferably at start
verification: Compare visible labels to computed accessible names for controls and voice commands
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Additional context is allowed, but visible words need to appear in name

title: Motion Actuation
symptom: Feature requires shaking, tilting or body movement without accessible alternative
remediation: Offer on-screen control and option to disable motion activation
verification: Operate function without motion and verify motion sensor can be disabled
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Exceptions for accessibility-supported interfaces and motion essential to function

title: Target Size
symptom: Small touch target is difficult to activate
remediation: Make targets at least 44 by 44 CSS px or meet an explicit exception
verification: Measure rendered target boxes on touch viewport and evaluate adjacent controls
exceptions_and_pitfalls: WCAG 2.1 AAA uses 44x44; do not substitute WCAG 2.2 AA target size 24x24 rule

title: Concurrent Input Mechanisms
symptom: Using one input type disables another available modality unnecessarily
remediation: Keep mouse, touch, stylus and keyboard mechanisms concurrently usable
verification: Switch modalities midtask and confirm state and function persist
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Essential, security and user-setting exceptions are possible

title: Dragging Movements
symptom: Reordering cards, moving a slider or drawing a route requires a continuous pointer drag without a simple alternative.
remediation: Provide a single-pointer operation without dragging for the same function: move-up/down controls, a click-to-place mode, direct setting, or accessible alternative.
verification: With touch or mouse, complete the full drag action using discrete presses or clicks without sustained dragging; verify keyboard operation independently.
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Dragging that is essential or performed by the user agent rather than authored interaction may be excepted; a keyboard-only alternative is not by itself sufficient for this pointer criterion.

title: Target Size (Minimum)
symptom: Small icon buttons or densely packed links cause missed activation for users with tremor or limited dexterity.
remediation: Give pointer targets at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels or ensure their applicable 24 CSS-pixel diameter spacing geometry satisfies the criterion. Enlarge hit areas without disrupting visual rhythm.
verification: Measure actual clickable geometry and spacing at tested zoom and responsive breakpoints; exercise tight controls via touch and pointer.
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Exceptions include equivalent controls, inline links, controls whose size is set by user agent and not altered, essential presentation, and applicable spacing. Do not confuse 24 CSS px AA with 44 CSS px AAA 2.5.5.

title: Language of Page
symptom: Screen reader pronounces all page content using wrong language
remediation: Set correct html lang for document's default human language
verification: Inspect lang and use assistive technology to listen to representative text
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Locale metadata and visual language switcher do not replace correct document language

title: Language of Parts
symptom: Foreign-language passage is spoken with wrong pronunciation rules
remediation: Mark passages with appropriate lang attributes where language changes
verification: Inspect language changes and listen with supported screen reader and voice
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Proper names, technical terms, indeterminate language and vernacular borrowings are excepted

title: Unusual Words
symptom: Jargon or unusual words are not explained
remediation: Provide a definition or explanation for jargon, idioms and unusual usages
verification: Review unfamiliar passages with representative readers and locate meaning on demand
exceptions_and_pitfalls: This is AAA and may be fulfilled by a mechanism for finding definitions

title: Abbreviations
symptom: Abbreviation expansion is inaccessible or unknown
remediation: Provide a mechanism for discovering expansions or meanings of abbreviations
verification: Test each ambiguous abbreviation in context using appropriate expansion method
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Context-specific meanings matter; abbr title alone may not work reliably in every assistive technology

title: Reading Level
symptom: Text requires advanced reading ability with no accessible explanatory alternative
remediation: Provide supplemental content or a version at lower secondary education reading level where applicable
verification: Assess text after removing proper names/titles and verify suitable supplementary explanation
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Not a simplistic instruction to shorten all technical material; criterion has defined scope

title: Pronunciation
symptom: Meaning depends on pronunciation but no pronunciation guidance exists
remediation: Provide accessible pronunciation or phonetic guidance where needed
verification: Identify ambiguous terms where pronunciation affects meaning and inspect cues
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Applies when pronunciation is necessary to understand meaning, not all unfamiliar words

title: On Focus
symptom: Focusing a control unexpectedly navigates or changes context
remediation: Keep focus passive; trigger meaningful context change only through explicit action
verification: Tab through controls without activation and monitor route, focus and context
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Showing help on focus is not automatically a prohibited context change

title: On Input
symptom: Changing selection automatically submits, navigates or moves focus without warning
remediation: Use explicit submit/update control or provide advance notice of context change
verification: Change all form values and verify no unannounced context-changing side effect
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Changing a value may update related content without being a context change

title: Consistent Navigation
symptom: Repeated navigation appears in different relative order across related pages
remediation: Use shared navigation component with stable ordering and placement
verification: Compare repeated navigation sequences across multiple routes and states
exceptions_and_pitfalls: User-initiated change of layout or menu arrangement is permitted

title: Consistent Identification
symptom: Same function is called different names or represented by changing icons
remediation: Use consistent accessible names, text and icons for same functionality
verification: Compare common actions across pages and responsive layouts
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Different functions can appropriately use different labels even if visually similar

title: Change on Request
symptom: An automatic context change happens without request or disable mechanism
remediation: Make context transitions user-initiated or offer a mechanism to turn off automatic changes
verification: Navigate and interact under idle and input transitions; inspect requests and options
exceptions_and_pitfalls: AAA requirement is stronger than the A focus/input requirements

title: Consistent Help
symptom: Help chat, contact details or support links change relative order between pages in a multi-page process.
remediation: When a repeated help mechanism appears on multiple pages, preserve its relative position in the sequence of those pages. Use shared page shells/components.
verification: Visit every in-scope page in the process and compare relative order of recurring help controls in DOM/focus/navigation sequence.
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Does not require adding help to pages lacking it; applies to repeated help mechanisms, such as human contact, human assistance, self-help, or automated contact.

title: Error Identification
symptom: Form marks fields red but does not identify errors in text
remediation: Name the fields in error and describe each error textually
verification: Submit invalid data, inspect messages and screen reader announcements
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Error identification does not guarantee suggestion quality; also inspect 3.3.3

title: Labels or Instructions
symptom: Users do not know what information to enter or what format is required
remediation: Provide persistent associated labels and relevant instructions before entry
verification: Review empty form and error states with keyboard and assistive technology
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Placeholder text alone is often not a reliable persistent label

title: Error Suggestion
symptom: System reports invalid input but no correction advice where one is known
remediation: Provide clear actionable suggestion unless doing so compromises security or purpose
verification: Enter foreseeable errors and inspect repair guidance in text and assistive technology
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Suggestion must be possible and safe; do not leak sensitive security data

title: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
symptom: Irreversible high-stakes submission lacks review, correction or reversal route
remediation: Offer reversible submission, correctable validation, or confirmation/review before finalization
verification: Run legal, financial, stored-data and test-answer submissions; verify one permitted safeguard
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Applies only to defined legal, financial, data and test response situations

title: Help
symptom: Users cannot find instructions or help for complicated input
remediation: Provide contextual guidance, contact details, or help mechanisms
verification: Complete difficult flows while looking for assistance at each key field
exceptions_and_pitfalls: AAA does not prescribe persistent live chat; right-sized help can qualify

title: Error Prevention (All)
symptom: Ordinary data submission lacks any reversal, error check or review process
remediation: Provide reversible entry, validation opportunity or review-and-confirm for user submissions
verification: Submit ordinary user data and verify at least one safeguard
exceptions_and_pitfalls: AAA expands 3.3.4 beyond high-stakes submission categories

title: Redundant Entry
symptom: A checkout or onboarding flow forces users to retype previously entered data in the same process.
remediation: Autopopulate previously entered values or provide a way to select them. Preserve explicit user correction, privacy and secure handling of sensitive fields.
verification: Complete a multi-step flow with known data; confirm repeat fields are populated or selectable rather than require recollection or typing.
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Exceptions include essential re-entry, information no longer valid and re-entry needed for security. Do not invent the contents of secrets, and do not reuse data outside the same process.

title: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
symptom: Login or 2FA blocks users behind a memory, transcription or puzzle task without a suitable alternative.
remediation: Support authentication without a cognitive function test, or provide an allowed mechanism/alternative: password-manager-friendly fields and paste, passkeys, secure magic links, accessible device-based flow, or other compliant assistive path.
verification: Verify password-manager/autofill and paste work, evaluate every sign-in/reset/recovery/MFA path, and independently test allowed alternatives with relevant users/assistive technologies.
exceptions_and_pitfalls: The criterion has defined exceptions including an assisting mechanism, recognizing objects, and identifying personal content; these are not a blanket approval for inaccessible CAPTCHAs or insecure workarounds.

title: Accessible Authentication (Enhanced)
symptom: An authentication method still requires object recognition or identifying personal content as a cognitive hurdle.
remediation: Provide a reliable route that avoids cognitive function tests or a permitted assistance mechanism; design passkey/autofill/paste-friendly login and accessible recovery as integrated functionality.
verification: End-to-end test sign-in, recovery and second factor without cognitive-memory or object-recognition requirements; verify the assistance path works across devices.
exceptions_and_pitfalls: AAA is stricter than 3.3.8 AA: recognizing objects and identifying personal content are not listed exceptions. Protect account security and avoid confusing an alternative login method with evidence that every barrier is resolved.

title: Name, Role, Value
symptom: Custom control lacks accessible name, correct role or exposed state and value
remediation: Prefer native elements; otherwise implement correct ARIA role, state, value and interaction behavior
verification: Inspect accessibility API tree; operate custom widget via keyboard and screen reader
exceptions_and_pitfalls: ARIA attributes do not implement interaction, focus or native browser behavior by themselves

title: Status Messages
symptom: Async validation, search results or success updates are invisible to assistive technology unless focus moves
remediation: Use role=status, appropriate aria-live regions or role=alert for critical updates without forcing focus
verification: Trigger async state changes while focus stays in place and confirm screen reader announcements
exceptions_and_pitfalls: Avoid excessive assertive live regions or duplicative announcements; errors may need focus separately
